available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac; no concurrent GPU assumption
accepted_scope: Seven standalone L1 formula/index/control components; one Google TPU paper is review-only. No checkpoints, capability datasets, paid API calls or full training.
estimated_component_cost: Small seeded matrices and deterministic state protocols; expected seconds to minutes for three seeds. This is a preflight estimate; actual times are in raw execution artifacts.
full_experiment_decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）

components.wesearch: CPU-only supplied-artifact OPQ/ADC, candidate union and fresh snapshot construction; no encoder/FFN/service
components.strategist: CPU-only blueprint/control/measurement/selection protocol; no frozen executor or meta-agent search
components.agentheal: CPU-only externally supplied evidence/provenance decisions; no browser actor or LLM judge
components.proland: Small thin-factor optimizer equivalence checks; no pretrained model fine-tuning
components.gavagai: Small capped-transport/grounding loss kernels; no multimodal backbone training
components.specopd: Small tree-mask/readout/loss tensor checks; no teacher/student LLM rollouts
components.rlid: Small menu-policy/calibration/objective checks; no LLM actor or environment rollouts
